title: RTP Player: Dialog is nonmodal now and can be called multiple ways
description:
Changes:
- refactored main_dialog handling of telephony dialogs
- RTP Player dialog is nonmodal now and can be left open
- it is possible to issue three actions on RTP Player dialog from other
  dialogs (other dialog have selected set of RTP streams before action)
  - replace - removes existing streams from RTP dialog and shows new set
  - add - adds new set to existing list in RTP dialog
  - remove - remove streams in set from list in RTP dialog
- Sequence Dialog:
  - was modified to hold rtpstream_info_t for RTP streams
  - added Play button
  - VoIP features (RTP Play button, select/deselect RTP stream) are
    disabled after creation and must be enabled. It handles that RTP
Play button is not shown e.g. in TCP sequence show

notes.body:
> VoIP features (RTP Play button, select/deselect RTP stream) are disabled after creation and must be enabled. It handles that RTP Play button is not shown e.g. in TCP sequence show

I.e., code that creates the player dialog can choose whether to add VoIP features or not, so dialogs where it would make no sense to have them can omit them?

Note: This change is related to Sequence Dialog and I must add it to same patch even it is different dialog than Play dialog.

Yes, in Sequence Dialog RTP related actions are disabled by default. When calling dialog wants to show it, it must be enabled by enableVoIPFeatures(). If found no better way how to code it :-(
